_readme: Hand-maintained corrections applied on top of the merged db tables, for cases where the
data the wiki reads is not what the wiki should show. Keep this small: a correction here
hides a real discrepancy, so each entry says why it exists and where the value comes from.
Applied by parse_tw3k_db.py; it fails loudly if a key here no longer exists.
rename: overrides forename / family_name (the resolved display strings, not name ids).
hide:   drops the template from the wiki entirely.
Every entry below traces to the MTU companion mod. Its _mtu_characters*.tsv files sort
after data__.tsv but before the mod's own ironic*.tsv, so for any character 190E does not
itself override, MTU's row wins. Reported in #website-feedback.
Before hiding a template, check family_tree.js and character_details.js for references to it - hiding the referenced one leaves dangling links that the audit will flag.

3k_main_template_historical_lady_cai_yan.why: MTU renames the family to Hua, so Cai Wenji shows as 'Hua Yan'. Reported 2026-07-26.

3k_dlc04_template_historical_luo_jun_xia.why: MTU renames the family to Lu, colliding with the two real Lu Juns. Reported 2026-03-11.

3k_main_template_historical_lady_guan_yi.why: MTU adds a second Guan Yinping and it is the one the mod actually uses: family_tree.js references the 3k_mtu_ template 17 times and this one zero times, and her unique armour ancillary is 3k_mtu_. So the vanilla template is the redundant one. Reported 2026-05-28.
